definitions.phase: both arms normalized over the whole operation (pipeline behaviour)
definitions.stage: both arms aligned by stage index and by fraction inside the stage
definitions.palm_distance_m: distance between the two palm face points
definitions.distal_clearance_m: min capsule clearance over forearm/hand pairs, radii subtracted
definitions.arm_arm_m: coarse all-segment arm-arm clearance, may be dominated by proximal links
